parse_teleop_demos_cli: run the CLI tool to parse MuJoCo tele-op demo logs from a directory of .mjl files
render_demos_function: render MuJoCo demo trajectories as video by setting joint positions without respecting physics simulation
gather_training_data_function: playback demo trajectories through the physics simulator to collect observation and action training data
viewer_function: render MuJoCo environment frames onscreen or offscreen to an RGB array buffer for video generation
main_entry: run the main CLI entry point with click options to parse, render, or playback tele-op demo logs
